resources.string: Watch the introduction to starting games and using the tools again
Tap this button to start a game.
Choose a difficulty here to start your game.
Select a cell, then tap a digit to fill it in. You can also select a digit first and tap cells to enter it repeatedly.
AN turns advanced notes on or off. When enabled, the digit buttons can highlight several digits and their candidates at once. Turn AN off to return to regular digit input.
You can watch this guide again in Settings → Assistance.
